sentences.indigenousText: Nga’ay ho kiso, singsi?
Hay, nga’ayay to. Kiso i?
Nga’ay to, ko’iday.
O mitakeciay kiso han?
Hay, o mitakeciay kako.
O mitakeciay cingra han?
Cowa, o singsi cingra.
Katomileng!
Kamaro’!
Sowalen!
Tengilen!
Cima kiso?
Ci Tomay kako.
Ci Mayaw ko ngangan ningra han?
Cowa, cowa ko ci Mayaw cingra, ci Kacaw ko ngangan ningra.
O fa’inayan kiso.
O fafahiyan kami.
O fa’inayan ci Panay han?
Cowa, o fafahiyan cingra.
Ira’ay ko cecay a waco no mako.
O kohetingay ko waco no mako.
Maolahay kako cingraan.
Maolah cingra takowanan.
Icowaay ko singsi no miso?
Ini cingra.
Icowa ko impic no miso?
Ira itira ko impic no mako.
O maan koninian?
O ^eto koninian.
’Aretengay koriraan a ’axenan han?
Hay, ’aretengay.
Cima korira tamdaw?
O wina no mako cingra.
Mimaanay ko demak ningra?
O mala kangkohoay cingra.
Iraay ko tilid i fafekang no ^eto han?
Toloay ko tilid i fafekang no ^eto.
Cecay ko kahengangay, tosa ko kohetingay.
sentences.chineseText: 一本是紅色的，兩本是黑色的。

sentences.indigenousText: Nima korira kahengangay a tilid?
No singsi korira kahengangay a tilid.

lessons.title: O paro no loma’ no mako

sentences.indigenousText: Lalimaay ko paro no loma’ no mako.
O fofo o wama o wina o fafahiyan a safa ato kako.
sentences.chineseText: 祖母、爸爸、媽媽、妹妹和我。

sentences.indigenousText: Mitakeci kako i kosiyaw a pitakecian.
Mitakeci ko fafahiyan a safa no mako i yociing.
sentences.chineseText: 我的妹妹在幼稚園讀書。

sentences.indigenousText: Pacelem, ina.
Pacelem kiso Calaw, atiati, maranamto.
Sawnito mi’ola’olho kako to wadis.
Mamisifinho kiso han?
Hay, ina.

lessons.title: Mo^tepay to ko mihecaan no mako

sentences.indigenousText: Pinaayto ko mihecaan no miso?
Mo^tepayto ko mihecaan no mako.
Papinaay kamo a malikaka?
Tatosaay ko kaka no mako to fa’inayan, cecay ko safa no mako to fafahiyan.
sentences.chineseText: 我有兩個哥哥和一個妹妹。

sentences.indigenousText: Pinaay ko mihecaan no safa no miso?
Enemay ko mihecaan no safa no mako.
Icowaay ko loma’ no miso?
I katimolay no fanaw ko loma’ no mako.
I ngataay no pitakcian ko loma’ namo han?
Hay, i ngataay no pitakcian ko loma’ no mako.
sentences.chineseText: 是的，我的家在學校附近。

sentences.indigenousText: Romakatay kako a tayra i pitakecian to romi’ami’ad.
Koras, nani cowa’ay kiso?
Nani Fanaway kako.
Tatalacowa kiso anocila?
Tatayra i Posong kako anocila.
Sahatilahanto no mita na’onen ko lakat.
Nga’ayay ko romi’ad anini.
Talalotok ko wama a mi’adop.
Mifaca’ ko wina to riko’ i ’alo.
Mihalama kako ato kaka no mako i loma’.
Mahadak ko cidal.
Dademakay ko wama ato wina.
Mahadak ko folad.
Minokayto ko wama ato wina.
Minengneng kita to fo’is.
Ma’oraday to.
Cidinayay kiso?
Icowaay ko dinay no miso?
Oninian ko dinay no mako.
O maan ko kodong no ’o’ol i kakarayan?
Kohecalay ko kodong no ’o’ol i kakarayan.
Makapahay nengnengen ko talakal ni Idek han?
Hay, ta:damakapahay nengnengen ko talakal ni Idek.
sentences.chineseText: 是的，彩虹看起來真美麗。

sentences.indigenousText: Ira ko masakenakenaay a congiliw i palapalaan.
Ira ko masakenakenaay a lengos i palapalaan.
Fliwsa ko fali salaheker sa cangra.
Hatoya o mita’ongay ko congiliw.
Hatoya o mipa’pa’ay to kamay ko lengos.
’Aloman ko widang no mako.
’Akawang ci Namoh, poener ci Mayaw.
Malalok ci Panay, matoka ci Dongi.
Malacafay kami to romiami’ad a mitakeci ato mihalama.
sentences.chineseText: 我們每天一起唸書和玩耍。

sentences.indigenousText: Pasowal ko singsi i kamiyanan.
Kangodoen ko malitengay.
To widang i kasasiolaolah kadadamadama.
sentences.chineseText: 對朋友要相親相愛，互相幫助。

sentences.indigenousText: Aka ka osoy a tayrapitakecian.
Aka pikadofah to paici.
Pasela’ a mitakeci, mahadak kako a tala potal no pitilidan.
Ira ko facidol i papotal no pitakecian.
sentences.chineseText: 教室的外面有一棵麵包樹。

sentences.indigenousText: Ira ko cecay a ’atipalay i fafekang no facidol.
sentences.chineseText: 在麵包樹上有一隻畫眉鳥。

sentences.indigenousText: Tanohoni sa korira ’atipalay.
Pacelem faki!
Talacowa kiso Panay?
Keriden no wina kako paising.
sentences.chineseText: 媽媽要帶我去給醫生看。

sentences.indigenousText: Mamaanay kiso?
Malalisanay kako.
O manan a onto ko kaolahan no miso?
O yakiw ko kaolahan no mako.
Misamaanay?
O sakanga’ay no tireng no mako.
Mafana’ kiso a romadiw han?
Hay, mafana’ kako a romadiw to nga’ayay tengilen a radiw.
Mafana’ kiso a makero han?
Hay, makapahay ko kero no mako.
Ano hatiraay i, tatata, makero kita!
Pinaay ko toki hatini?
Falo^ay ko toki to papacem.
Pinaay ko toki a lomowad kiso to papacem?
^Nemay ko toki a lomowad kako.
Pinaay ko toki a mafoti’ kiso?
Siwa ira ko kalitosa no toki a mafoti’ kako.
Nga’ay ho, ci Ongo kako, i loma’ ci Fadah han?
Ci Sawmah kako, awaay ko kaka ako ci Fadah i loma’, mahadakay cingra.
sentences.chineseText: 我是Sawmah，我姊姊Fadah不在家，她出去了。

sentences.indigenousText: Ha! Anohacowa a minokay cingra?
Cowa pahoda, ira anosawni.
Talacowaay kiso i nacila?
Talalotokay kami a miliso’ to fofoan.
O manan ko sapatala no fofo i tamowanan?
O lawal, o hemay ato dongec.
sentences.chineseText: 阿公請我們吃飛鼠肉、麻糬和藤心湯。

sentences.indigenousText: Mafana’ay kako micoka.
O mamicoka kako to wina^an.
Makapah ko mata no wina^.
Kamelengay ko fokes nira.
Micelem to ko cidal, kato’emanan to.
To’eman to, mahoni to ko takola’.
Mahoni to ko takola’, mahadak to ko folad.
Mahadak to ko folad, mapalal to ko ekong.
sentences.chineseText: 月亮出來了，貓頭鷹睡醒了。

sentences.indigenousText: Macidalay anini han?
Hay, fa^det ko romi’ad anini.
Citalopongay ko wina a mahadak han?
sentences.chineseText: 媽媽外出的時候，有戴帽子嗎？

sentences.indigenousText: Cowa, matawalay citalopong cingra.
Nga’ay kako a mihalama i halek no lahok han?
Akaa, ta’akayay ko’orad i papotal.
Ano masa’sa’ to ko ’orad i, nga’ay kako a mahadak han?
sentences.chineseText: 如果雨停了，我可以出去嗎？

sentences.indigenousText: Nga’ay to, aka ka walawal a minokay to kalafian!
sentences.chineseText: 可以，不要忘了（記得）傍晚要回來喔！

sentences.indigenousText: O kahofocan no fofo anocila.
Misahemay kako ato kaka anini.
sentences.chineseText: 今天我和姊姊一起做了麻糬。

sentences.indigenousText: O sapatelong niyam to fofoan.
Nanay lipahak cingra.
Cima hani?
Kami, ci Kolas aci Dongi, fawahen ho ko sa^def, fofo.
O kamo han, ma’ilolto kako tamowanan.
sentences.chineseText: 原來是你們，我好想念你們。

sentences.indigenousText: Fofo o kahofocan no miso anini, nanay lipahak kiso.
Kepit han no fofo ko mata a mitolon,
toloay ko mitokeran no faloco’ ningra.
Nanay talifaken ko tireng no namo.
Nanay lipahak kita.
sentences.chineseText: 希望我們全家人都平安。

sentences.indigenousText: Nanay adihay ko malidongay anini a mihecaan.
Pina a romi’ad ko cecay a lipay?
Pito ko romi’ad.
Sakapina no lipay anini?
O pilipayan anini.
Tatayra i kiwkay kami a milihay.
Talolongay ko ’alo to kacidalan.
Nikawrira, pangtaay ko ’alo to kasi^enawan.
Kacidalan to hatini, mihifang to kita.
sentences.chineseText: 現在是夏天，我們放暑假。

sentences.indigenousText: Kaora i, adihay ko faliyos.
Mafaliyosay anini, talapitakecian kamo han?
sentences.chineseText: 今天颱風，你們需要上學嗎？

sentences.indigenousText: Cowa ko tatayra i pitakecian kami anini.
Akaa kahadak i loma’ kamo!
Hay, mafana’ to kami.
O kafalawfawan to, karoheman to no ’asilo.
Ira ko kangdaway, o kahengangay, o kaliyawliyaway i ’apilipilisan.
sentences.chineseText: 山坡上，有綠有紅也有黃。

sentences.indigenousText: Talalotokay ca Panay a mipitpit to ’asilo.
Tangsol matomes ko kadango nangra.
sentences.chineseText: 他們的簍子，一下子就裝滿了。

sentences.indigenousText: O madadoyodoyongay a kakonah kami.
Malalok kami a matayal.
O malaslassay i sera a posak ato fao.
Colo’en niyam a panokay.
O malalokay a kakonah kami.
sentences.chineseText: 我們是一群勤快的螞蟻。

sentences.indigenousText: Icowa ci Rongac aci Maro’?
I ontofaay cangra.
Malalifet cangra a comikay.
Cima ko i ’a’ayaway?
Ci Rongac.
Nawhani misaromi’ami’ad misa’icel a mihatatanam cingra.
Mawmahay ko wama no mako.
Kinafalah sa cingra a mawmah i ^can.
sentences.chineseText: 他每天辛勤地在田裡耕作。

sentences.indigenousText: Paharhar sa to fongoh i cidar.
Macepa’ no sinoet ko riko’ ningra.
Anini a mihecaan, adihay ko malidongay a panay.
Lipahak sanay ko wama a matawa.
Ira ko cecay a tingsiya no mako.
Pakatingsiya sanay kako a talapitakecian to romi’ami’ad.
Cecay a romi’ad, i fatad no lalan,
mapalak ko tingsiya no mako.
Ira ko cecay fangcalay ko faloco’ a faki mita’elif,
sentences.chineseText: 有一位好心的叔叔經過，

sentences.indigenousText: sanga’en ningra ko tingsiya no mako.
O maan ko mikalican talaTaypak?
Mikalic to ci’acefelay.
Pina ko tatokian nga’ tahila?
Ma^deng tolo a tatokian.
Icowaay ko kalekiay no ci’acefelay ato faso?
sentences.chineseText: 火車和公車哪一個比較快呢？

sentences.indigenousText: O ci’acefelay ko kalekiay.
Adihay ko citosiya i lalan.
Na’onen ko rakat.
Kasalayalay a mikalic to faso.
Kacita^kokay a pakaotofay.
sentences.chineseText: 騎摩托車一定要戴安全帽。

sentences.indigenousText: Adihay ko lotok no Taywan.
O sa’akawangay a lotok i o I-san.
Mangata no lotok ko niyaro’ namo han?
sentences.chineseText: 你們的部落附近有山嗎？

sentences.indigenousText: Hay, mataliyokay no lotok ko niyaro’ niyam.
sentences.chineseText: 是的，我們的部落四面環山。

sentences.indigenousText: Ira ko ’akawangay, ira ko po^neray.
sentences.chineseText: 有的比較高，有的比較矮。

sentences.indigenousText: Palicayho, icowa ko Kadokapok?
I katimol ko Kadokapok.
Palicayho, samaanen tayra niyaro’ no Kadokapok?
Pasitimol han ko rakat tahilato.
Hakowa ko raay?
Ma^deng kalitosa no toki.
O maan ko iraay i riyar?
O foting, o ’afar, o kalang.
Pina ko oo no kalang?
Faloay ko oo.
Samanay a nanomen ko nanom no riyar?
Kaheciday ko nanom no riyar.
Marariday a tara riyar a mifoting ko mifotingay.
Ano ta’ata’akay ko fali.
Ano ’akawakawang ko tapelik.
Cowa ka talaw cingra.
Cowa ka^eca matomes ko tamina to foting ato ’afar.
sentences.chineseText: 船上總是裝滿了魚和蝦。

sentences.indigenousText: Fofo, tahalomay’ to kako.
Ha, tahaloma’ay to nai pitakecian kiso!
Macahiway kako.
O maan ko kaolahan no miso?
Kaolahan no mako o tali.
Ira i ^to ko tali, alaen oli.

lessons.title: O maan ko kaolahan no miso a kakaenen

sentences.indigenousText: O maan ko kaolahan no miso a kakaenen?
O holo, o maan ko no miso?
O hemay ko han no mako, mapili’ay kako to holo.
sentences.chineseText: 我喜歡吃麻糬，不喜歡吃飯。

sentences.indigenousText: O maan ko sapisahemay, mafana’ kiso han?
sentences.chineseText: 你知道麻糬是用什麼做的嗎？

sentences.indigenousText: Cowa kafana’ kako.
Pasowalen no mako kiso, o ko^tengay ko sapisahemay.
sentences.chineseText: 我告訴你，麻糬是用糯米做的。

sentences.indigenousText: Dada, kamaro’, o maan ko kaolahan no miso a komaen?
Ira ko holo han?
Samaanen, awaay ko holo itini, deng o towami aca’.
sentences.chineseText: 抱歉，這裡沒有飯，只有麵。

sentences.indigenousText: Nga’ay to, o towami ko han no mako.
Maolah kiso to kacedahay han?
Hamaan, matalaw kako komaen to kacedahay.
Sowalen hena, o maamaan a soyko ko iraay itini i Taywan?
sentences.chineseText: 說說看，台灣有哪些水果？

sentences.indigenousText: Ira ko kidafes, o kowa’, o pawli, ato masamaamaanay.
sentences.chineseText: 有芭樂，木瓜和香蕉，還有很多很多。

sentences.indigenousText: Komaen to soyko kiso to romi’ami’ad han?
Cowa, cokahalikaen kako to soyko.
Adihayen komikaenan nga’ ci’icel.
sentences.chineseText: 多吃水果，身體才有力量。

sentences.indigenousText: Ira ko losay no loma’ namo han?
Irato, ira ko kidafes i ka’ayaw no loma’ niyam, ira ko ’alopal i kaikoran no loma’ niyam.
sentences.chineseText: 有，我們家前面有芭樂，後面有柿子。

sentences.indigenousText: Ciheci to mihecahecaan kolaan a losay han?
sentences.chineseText: 那些果樹每年結果實嗎？

sentences.indigenousText: Hay, samanen mararid a macidal, saka, ’alosaysay sa ko heci.
sentences.chineseText: 是的，因為陽光充足，所以結很多果實。

sentences.indigenousText: Ira i pin-siyang ko kacawasay han?
Ira to, o mi’acaan no wama i nacila.
Tadafa^det ko romi’ad, ka^nen no mita!
Dada, kaenen!
Pacinahen to miming nga’ ka’eso’ a kaenen.
Singsi, adadaay ko wadis no mako.
Tadaadihay ko mikaenan no miso to ’odax han?
sentences.chineseText: 你是不是吃太多糖果了？

sentences.indigenousText: Mangotngot ano adihaytato ko kakomaen to ’odax.
sentences.chineseText: 如果糖果吃太多，就會蛀牙。

sentences.indigenousText: Samanen to no mako hokiya?
Kalikien a paising.
Ikor toninian akato kahalikaen to ’odax, kalalok a mi’ola’ol to wadis.
sentences.chineseText: 今後不要再貪吃糖果，多刷牙。

sentences.indigenousText: Masatamdaway a wawa sanay ko singsi a masemel i takowanan.
sentences.chineseText: 老師稱讚我是一個很乖的小孩。

sentences.indigenousText: Nawhani, ’ayaw no taheka i minanaw kako to kamay.
sentences.chineseText: 因為，我在吃飯之前會洗手。

sentences.indigenousText: ’Eminen no mako a komaen ko kakaenen i kaysing.
Ikol no taheka i, mi’ola’ol kako to wadis.
Mafana’ haca kako a pacafay mifanaw to kaysing, to piyal ato ’alapit.
sentences.chineseText: 我還會幫忙洗碗盤和筷子。

sentences.indigenousText: Ira ko titi no koko’, o fita’ol, o kalitang ato lokoc ko sakalahok niyam anini.
sentences.chineseText: 今天的午餐有雞肉、蛋、四季豆，還有山蘇。

sentences.indigenousText: O sakalahok namo i pitakecian koninian han?
sentences.chineseText: 這些是學校的營養午餐嗎？

sentences.indigenousText: Hay, o nisadayan no pitakecian.
sentences.chineseText: 是的，這些是學校為我們準備的。

sentences.indigenousText: Mafecolay kamo?
Hay, ka^so’ ko lahok niyam.
Na mihalama kako i papacem, mapolin kako.
sentences.chineseText: 今天早上，我在玩耍的時候跌倒了。

sentences.indigenousText: Madoka’ ma’ilang ko toros no mako.
Sipasipen no singsi to cemel nga’ tafoen nira ko doka no mako.
sentences.chineseText: 老師為我擦藥，包紮我的傷口。

sentences.indigenousText: So’elin, romakat kako hatini, mapi’iway ho kako,
sentences.chineseText: 我雖然現在走路一跛一跛地，

sentences.indigenousText: kawraan, o mamaadah to kako anocila.
Wawa, o maan ko mi’acaan no miso?
Tawki, mi’aca kako to impic ato ciwming.
sentences.chineseText: 老闆，我要買鉛筆和筆記本。

sentences.indigenousText: Pina ko a’acaen no miso?
Cecay ko impic, cecay ko ciwming.
sentences.chineseText: 鉛筆一枝，筆記本也一本。

sentences.indigenousText: Cecay ko impic lima a limo’od, cecay ko ciwming siwa a limo’od.
sentences.chineseText: 鉛筆一枝五元，筆記本一本九元。

sentences.indigenousText: Lima tongalen to siwa, makomod mo^etep ira ko sepat a limo’od.
Tawki, somo’otay ko payci no mako, wamifalic kako.
sentences.chineseText: 老闆，我有一百元，我想換錢。

sentences.indigenousText: Samaanen no miso a mifalic?
Mifalic kako to mo^etep a mo^etepay a limo’od.
Nga’ay to! Mo^etep, tosa polo’, tolo polo’, sepat polo’, lima polo’, enem polo’, pito polo’, falo polo’, siwa polo’. Aya! Cango^otay, siwaay polo’ aca’.
sentences.chineseText: 可以啊！十、二十、三十、四十、五十、六十、七十、八十、九十。啊呀！不夠，只有九十元。

sentences.indigenousText: Nga’ayay to, pafeli han kako to tosa limaay a limo’od.
sentences.chineseText: 沒關係，你可以再給我兩個五元。

sentences.indigenousText: Pafelien no wina kako to lima polo’ a payci to pilipalipayan.
sentences.chineseText: 媽媽每星期給五十元（銅板）。

sentences.indigenousText: Mihopedan no mako ko tosa polo’ a payci.
Ano taangay to kako, adihay to ko payso no mako.
sentences.chineseText: 我長大之後，就會有很多錢（鈔票）。

sentences.indigenousText: Sowal sa ko singsi, “Hopeden ko mimimi:ming nga’ mahopeday to.” sanay.
So’elinay to koni a sowal.
Tosa ko rinom no toki.
Cecay ko’edaway ato cecay kamoto’ay.
Kalikiay ko rakat no ko’edaway a rinom, cecay a romi’ad kina tosa polo’ ira ko sepat a mitaliyok.
sentences.chineseText: 長針走得快，一天走二十四圈。

sentences.indigenousText: Mana’on ko rakat no kamoto’ay, cecay a romi’ad kina tosa a mitaliyok.
sentences.chineseText: 短針走得慢，一天走兩圈。

sentences.indigenousText: Nano papacem tahila i dadaya, cowa ka pasela’.
sentences.chineseText: 從早上到晚上，不停地走。

sentences.indigenousText: Kalimelaen ko romi’ad, hato sanay kitaanan.
sentences.chineseText: 好像在告訴我們，要愛惜時間。

sentences.indigenousText: Pafeli ko wama i takowanan to fa’elohay a toki.
Satokien no mako to romi’ami’ad.
Tiktak tiktak sanay ko honi nira.
sentences.chineseText: 它發出的聲音，滴答滴答。

sentences.indigenousText: Ano talapitakecian to anca’ minokay to,
papitalipaelalay i takowanan a pitool to toki.

lessons.title: O demak no wina to romi’admi’ad

sentences.indigenousText: Enem ko toki to papacem, mipalalan to no wina kako.
sentences.chineseText: 早上六點鐘，媽媽叫我起床。

sentences.indigenousText: Marawed ko kalahokan, misakalahok to cingra.
Helek no lahok tolo ko toki, tayra i loma’ ni fayi a miteno’oy ko wina.
sentences.chineseText: 下午三點，媽媽到阿姨家織布。

sentences.indigenousText: Tenok to no lafii dademakay ho cingra.
Nai papacem tahila i dadaya, cowa ka pasela cingra.
sentences.chineseText: 從早上到晚上，她都沒有休息。

sentences.indigenousText: Tadamarorayay ko wina.
Mamo^etepay ko siri ni Kolas.
Pakaen to siri cingra to romi’ami’ad.
Osien ho, iraay ko mahidayay?
Cecay, tosa, tolo, sepat, lima, enem, pito, falo, siwa, awaay ko cecay.
sentences.chineseText: 一、二、三、四、五、六、七、八、九，少了一隻。

sentences.indigenousText: Kalikien a mikilim, icowaay cira hokiya?
sentences.chineseText: 趕快去找，不知道牠在哪裡？

sentences.indigenousText: Makilimay to, arawhan itilaay i kaikol no ’ongcoy a milimek.
sentences.chineseText: 找到了，原來躲在大石頭的後面。

sentences.indigenousText: Maolahay ko ’oner a mahadak to dadaya.
Marariday cira i soemetay a pala ato fakelokelohan a milimek.
sentences.chineseText: 牠經常躲在潮濕的地方和石頭堆裡。

sentences.indigenousText: Ano mingatowa ko ngoyos i, cowa to ka kiyamaw a milaliw ko ’edo ato takora’.
sentences.chineseText: 只要張開嘴，老鼠和青蛙都很難逃開。

sentences.indigenousText: Makapahay a nengnengen ko ’adipangpang.
Iti:ya ho, o salipana’ cira.
Anini i, ci ca’edong to cira to cisapikpikay a riko’.
sentences.chineseText: 現在，牠穿著美麗的翼衣服。

sentences.indigenousText: I hanahanaan a misa’efe’efer.
Halatengen! Tahacifek i kadamatay.

lessons.title: Misamanay hano kahengang ko hemot no lotong?
lessons.titleCh: 猴子的屁股為什麼是紅色的？

sentences.indigenousText: Iti:ya ho, misamsaman no lotong ko ’alem.
Ano sapahadakaw to ’alem, dohdohen ko namal i ofang.
sentences.chineseText: 想要使穿山甲出來，放火煙燻洞穴。

sentences.indigenousText: Arawhan, rengreng sanay ko namal.
Matodohay ko hemot no niyah.
Naitiya to, kahengangayay to ko hemot no lotong.
sentences.chineseText: 從那時候，猴子的屁股就變成紅色了。

sentences.indigenousText: Mafana’ kiso somowal to no ’Amis han?
Pangtaay ko kafana’an, minanam ho kako no hatini.
Icowa kiso a minanam to sowal no ’Amis?
I pitakecian kako a minanam.
Nga’ayay a nanamen ko sowal no ’Amis han?
Nga’ayay a nanamen, sakahemekan.
Tadamafana’ay kiso a caciyaw to no ’Amis.
O Yin-co-min kamo han?
Hay, o Yin-co-min kami.
O Pariwan kamo han?
Cowa, o ’Amis kami.
O ’Amis a tamdaw ko ’alomanay i niyaro’ niyam.
sentences.chineseText: 我們村子裡的人大多是阿美族。

sentences.indigenousText: Matenak i pasawali ato i katimolan no Taywan ko ’Amis.
sentences.chineseText: 我們阿美族分佈在台灣的東部和南部。

sentences.indigenousText: Mafana’ ko fofo a mitawciker.
Marariday kako maro’ i lidong no kilang a mitengil to tawciker no fofo.
sentences.chineseText: 我常常坐在樹蔭下，聽阿公說故事。

sentences.indigenousText: Mafana’ cingra to adihayay katawaan a tawciker, tinakoen misamaanay ko satapangan no hekar ato naicowaay ko tamdawan a ira sanay.
sentences.chineseText: 他知道許多精彩的故事，例如世界怎麼樣開始，還有人類從哪裡來。

sentences.indigenousText: Ano o kalipahakan ato kararoman a tawciker i, tadamaolahay kako.
sentences.chineseText: 不論是快樂的故事和悲傷的故事，我都很喜歡。

sentences.indigenousText: Tanolokoongan no mako a milokoong ko tawcikel no fofo.
sentences.chineseText: 我用錄音機錄下阿公講的故事。

sentences.indigenousText: Mapolong kami ato kapot a mitengil.
Cima ko mikingkiway to tingwa?
Icowaay ko sa’akawangay a loma’?
O maan ko sakasasela’ no foting?
Misamanay hano makakereng ko kakarayan?
Icowa a mikilim to sapaca’of?
I tilid, malalok a mitakeci i, matongal ko inaneng no mita.
sentences.chineseText: 在書裡，勤讀書可以讓我們增加知識。

sentences.indigenousText: Ma’osiay to iso ko “Mayaw Kakalawan” a kimad han?
sentences.chineseText: 你讀過Mayaw Kakalawan的神話故事嗎？

sentences.indigenousText: Ma’osiay to no mako. Nga’ayay a ’osien kona tilid.
Wa nga’ay caliwen no mako koni a tilid han?
sentences.chineseText: 那麼我可以向你借這本書嗎？

sentences.indigenousText: Awaay ko no mako, kawrira iraay ko ni Panay, tanamen ako a milicay hena.
sentences.chineseText: 我是沒有，但是我知道Panay有，我試著幫你問問看。

sentences.indigenousText: Ano ira a macaliw, pafeli han to kako, ko’iday.
sentences.chineseText: 謝謝，如果借到的話，請你拿給我。

sentences.indigenousText: Hay! Kawrira, ano maharek a mi’osi, aka^ca ka patikolen no miso ci Panay.
sentences.chineseText: 好的，不過看完的時候，你必須自已還給Panay。

sentences.indigenousText: Malacafay kako ato kapot tayra i pi’acaan to tilid i nacila.
sentences.chineseText: 昨天我和同學一起到書店去。

sentences.indigenousText: Sapi’acaaw kami to citing ato tawciker a tilid.
sentences.chineseText: 我們都想買字典和故事書。

sentences.indigenousText: Alawhan mahecad ko mi’acaan niyam tatosa a citing.
sentences.chineseText: 結果我們兩人各買了一本相同的字典。

sentences.indigenousText: Kawrira cowa ka hecad ko mi’acaan niyam a mitawcikeray a tilid.
sentences.chineseText: 但是我們買的故事書卻不同。

sentences.indigenousText: No ka’emangay a kongko ni Antosen ko ni’acaan ningra. O mikimaday ni Isop ko ni’acaan no mako.
sentences.chineseText: 他買的是《安徒生童話》。我買的是《伊索寓言》。

sentences.indigenousText: So’elin caka hecad ko ni’acaan a tilid, kawrira mahecaday ko ’aca.
sentences.chineseText: 雖然買的書不同，但是價錢是剛好相同。

sentences.indigenousText: Mihatatanamay kako a mitilid.
Nanay kahenay kako a mafana’.
Ano mafana’ to kako a mitilid i,
patikami’en to no mako ko kaka ako.
Matayalay i Taypak cingra, tadama’ilol kako cingraan.
sentences.chineseText: 他在台北工作，我很想念他。

sentences.indigenousText: Masamaanay to ko ka’orip nangra hokini?
sentences.chineseText: 不知道他們的生活過得怎麼樣？

sentences.indigenousText: Nga’ay ho, ko miso kaka.
Tadamahemekay kako a macada ko tikami no miso anini.
sentences.chineseText: 今天接到你的信，我非常高興。

sentences.indigenousText: Maolahay kako toya sapafeli no miso i takowanan to tolo a tilid i’ayaw no folad.
sentences.chineseText: 上個月你送給我的三本書，我都很喜歡。

sentences.indigenousText: Micodiapay to kiso sanay ko matengilay, wa malasingsi to.
sentences.chineseText: 聽說你畢業了，就要成為老師。

sentences.indigenousText: Sa’icelen no mako a mitakeci.
Nanay mahecad kako i kisowanan, a ira mala’idahiyay a singsi.
sentences.chineseText: 希望和你一樣，將來做個優秀的老師。

sentences.indigenousText: Mitilid kako to Re-ci to romi’ami’ad.
Mitilidan no mako ko tahalifaan a demak to romi’ami’ad.
sentences.chineseText: 我把每天遇到的事記下來。

sentences.indigenousText: Haenen no mako, mahecaday to mihatatanamay a mitiliday.
sentences.chineseText: 我這樣做，等於可以練習寫字。

sentences.indigenousText: Wa nga’ay mapalahad ko miem^emay a faloco’ no mako.
Adihay ko matiliday to iti:yaay ho a demak no mako i Re-ci.
sentences.chineseText: 日記裡寫下許多我過去的事。

sentences.indigenousText: Wa songila’en no mako a milosimet ci mira.
Ca’edongay to kangdaway a riko ko Hay-tac.
Patado to tamdamdaw a pakilac to tikami to romi’ami’ad.
Ano ma’orad to anca macidal to,
hacecacecay han ningra a palilam ko tikami i lomaloma’an.
sentences.chineseText: 他把信一封一封的送到每個家。

sentences.indigenousText: Mahemekay ko tamdamdaw a pakacada to tikami.
sentences.chineseText: 人們收到了信，都很高興。

sentences.indigenousText: Rahekeray ko faloco’ no Hay-tac.
sentences.chineseText: 郵差的心裡也感到很滿足。

sentences.indigenousText: Ano citama’ ko mi’adopay a finacadang no niyam, mipafatisan ko fiyafiyaw to tama’.
sentences.chineseText: 我們的族人去打獵有所捕獲，會把獵物分享給鄰居（親友）。

sentences.indigenousText: Ano ira ko nai raayay a lafang miliso, o ciloma’ay mihadakay to tadakaeso’ay a kakaenen.
sentences.chineseText: 如果來自遠方的客人來拜訪，主人會把最美味的食物拿出來。

sentences.indigenousText: I pi’ilisinan no niyaro’, misahemayay, mitokaday to diyong ato mihadakay to kinafangan a ’epah cangra.
sentences.chineseText: 在部落裡舉行祭典時，他們舂打粢粑，殺豬，以及擺出釀造的小米酒。

sentences.indigenousText: O pinangan no lalitengan no ’Amis konini.
sentences.chineseText: 這是阿美族的傳統習俗。

sentences.indigenousText: Sowal no malitengay, “Mahoni ko kiyap o mama’orad, mahoni ko topi o mamacidal.”
sentences.chineseText: 老人常說：「樹蛙鳴必降雨，鴿子叫必天晴。」

sentences.indigenousText: O tatodong nonini a sowal i,
ano matengil ko honi no kiyap to dadaya, ano saan cowa ka’eca ka ’orad to cila.
sentences.chineseText: 如果夜裡聽見樹蛙叫的聲音，那麼隔天一定會下雨。

sentences.indigenousText: Ano tikokoy sa ko topi to papacem, ano saan cowa ka’eca ka cidal ko romi’ad.
sentences.chineseText: 如果早晨時聽見鴿子的鳴啼聲，那麼天氣一定晴朗。

sentences.indigenousText: O mihopedan no lalitengan a milifetan i ’orip konini.
sentences.chineseText: 這是袓先生活經驗的累積。

sentences.indigenousText: Talacowa caay ka lalocek, kawrira o so’elinay konini.
sentences.chineseText: 雖然不一定可靠，但是通常很靈。

sentences.indigenousText: Pakafana’ ko singsi tamiyanan a misanga’ to datok anini.
sentences.chineseText: 今天老師教我們製作口簧琴。

sentences.indigenousText: O maan ko datok?
O mikingkiwan no malitengay niyam a tahonian ci mira, tano a’olan a misanga’.
sentences.chineseText: 它是我們祖先發明的樂器，是用竹子做成的。

sentences.indigenousText: I hacowa ko piiyofan to datok?
sentences.chineseText: 什麼時侯可以吹口簧琴？

sentences.indigenousText: Itini i paaliwacan no mawmahay ko nga’ayay.
Kawrira, ano ira ko mapatayay no loma’, cowa kanga’ay a miiyof, ano’eca mapaysinay.
sentences.chineseText: 但是如果家裡親人去世，就不能吹奏，否則會觸犯禁忌。

sentences.indigenousText: Ira ko loma’, palofoan ato pikecolan i niyaro’ niyam.
sentences.chineseText: 我們的部落有房舍、穀倉和瞭望台。

sentences.indigenousText: O pisasiemelan ato pisadihekoan niyam ko loma’.
sentences.chineseText: 房舍讓我們乘涼和取暖。

sentences.indigenousText: O pina’engan to milidongan ko palofoan, sakaecaaw kakaen no ’edo.
sentences.chineseText: 穀倉用來存放農作物，防止老鼠偷吃。

sentences.indigenousText: Ira i sacomod no niyaro’ ko pikecolan, o hasapisolap to temik no ’ada.
sentences.chineseText: 瞭望台在部落的入口，用来觀察敵人的動靜。

sentences.indigenousText: O nanolalitengan a patilengan no niyam o ’Amis konini.
sentences.chineseText: 這是我們阿美族的傳統建築。

sentences.indigenousText: O Fanaw kora maaraway a niyaro’.
sentences.chineseText: 那個可以看到的部落是池上鄉。

sentences.indigenousText: Ira ko misasingdiay, Yu-fing ato paisingan itira.
sentences.chineseText: 那裡有商店、郵局和醫院。

sentences.indigenousText: Nga’ayay tayra kita i pisasingdian a mi’aca to dafong.
sentences.chineseText: 我們可以到商店買東西。

sentences.indigenousText: Nga’ayay tayra i Yo-fing a miciwking, militod to payci ato palingad to tikami.
sentences.chineseText: 也可以到郵局存錢、領錢和寄信。

sentences.indigenousText: Ano adada i, wanga’ay tayra i ising a paising.
sentences.chineseText: 如果生病了，可以到醫院看病。

sentences.indigenousText: O sakasiloway no ’orip no mita onian a nipatirengan no anini’ay.
sentences.chineseText: 這些現代的設施使我們的生活方便。

sentences.indigenousText: Makomod ko tamdaw no Yin-co-min i Taywan maedeng tosaay a pa-sin-to.
sentences.chineseText: 原住民的人口佔台灣總人口的2%。

sentences.indigenousText: Ma’edeng ira ko kalitosa a tamdaw i niyaro’ay.
sentences.chineseText: 大約還有一半的人住在部落裡。

sentences.indigenousText: O roma a kalitosa itiraay to i tokay a maro’.
sentences.chineseText: 另一半的人已經住在都市裡了。

sentences.indigenousText: Adihayay ko kadademakan i tokay, mansa masolot ko kapah ato kay^ing.
sentences.chineseText: 都市的工作機會多，所以吸引男女青年。

sentences.indigenousText: I tokay a misapalod cangra, itiraay to a dademak.
sentences.chineseText: 他們已在都市成家，工作也在那裡。

sentences.indigenousText: Mansa, alomanay to ko teloc no Yin-co-min i tokay a lomahad no hatini.
sentences.chineseText: 所以，現在有許多的原住民的後代在都市長大。

sentences.indigenousText: La’ed no kafaloan a folad tahila i kasiwaan a folad no mihecahecaan, o piilisinan no niyaro’ niyam.
sentences.chineseText: 每年的八月到九月之間，我們的部落舉行豐年祭。

sentences.indigenousText: O tadakalimelaan a romi’ad no niyaro’ konini, hanaca o kasa’opoan no kasalalomaloma’an a tatokian.
sentences.chineseText: 這是部落最重要的日子，也是每個家族團聚的時刻。

sentences.indigenousText: Romadiw ato makero’ ko ’alomanay i papotal a ma’acang to pakadofah no milidongan.
sentences.chineseText: 大家在廣場上唱歌和跳舞來慶祝豐收。

sentences.indigenousText: Anini a mihecaan, pakahikoki sanay ko paro no loma’ ni faki a minokay nai Taypak.
sentences.chineseText: 今年，叔叔全家人從台北搭飛機回來。

sentences.indigenousText: Sowal no kaka, “O ilisin no niyaro’ ko ka’ilolan niyam i Taypak.” sanay.
sentences.chineseText: 哥哥說：「我們在台北最懷念的，就是家鄉的豐年祭。」

sentences.indigenousText: Sariko:ray to sakero a kamok no ilisin anini a romi’ad.
sentences.chineseText: 今天是豐年祭歌舞節目的最後一天。

sentences.indigenousText: Macakat i fadahong no kakitaan ko mi’edaway, mifasfas to kinafangan. Nanay ma’adah ko kaloadada no tamdamdaw sanay.
sentences.chineseText: 女祭司爬上宗祠的屋頂，向大眾撒甜酒。以示驅邪並治好大眾各種疾病。

sentences.indigenousText: Miliyaw a macakat tayra i fadahong no kakitaan ko mi’edaway, mifolesak to micikcikan a ’icep. Nanay mapalemed ko i niyaro’ay a kapah talalotok a mi’adop talariyal a mifoting sakafangcal ira ko tama’.
sentences.chineseText: 女祭司再次爬到宗祠的屋頂上，向大眾撒檳榔切片。以示祝福部落青年上山打獵下海漁撈順遂、常有獵獲。

sentences.indigenousText: Komod han a patakid ko mi’aday ato pakalemed a demak anini.
sentences.chineseText: 今天把祈福和祝福儀式合併做敬酒。

sentences.indigenousText: O paka^timay hananay no ’Amis ko mararamoday a tatosa a tamdaw.
sentences.chineseText: 阿美族人把兩人結為連理作為結婚的意思。

sentences.indigenousText: Ano ira ko paka^timay no niyaro’, o ta’angayay a demak no ngangasawan.
sentences.chineseText: 部落裡有人結婚，是整個氏族的大事。

sentences.indigenousText: Misaday ko paka^timay a loma’ to silaw ato kinafangan a ’epah sapaka’en to salawinawina.
sentences.chineseText: 結婚者家裡會準備鹹豬肉和糯米酒宴請親友。

sentences.indigenousText: Mafafalic ko mararamoday to sapatapang.
sentences.chineseText: 結婚的夫妻要交換定情物。

sentences.indigenousText: Kimaden ho no faki cangra, palemeden no finawlan cangra.
sentences.chineseText: 伯父會給他們訓話，族人會給他們祝福。

sentences.indigenousText: O picodiyapan niyam a romi’ad anini.
sentences.chineseText: 今天是我們畢業的日子。

sentences.indigenousText: Mitahidangan no pitakecian ko malitengay pakayni tamiyanan i misaselal a demak.
sentences.chineseText: 學校請長老為我們舉辦成年禮。

sentences.indigenousText: Palalifeten no malitengay kami a mipana’.
Pakalowiday a mitiliday nga’ nga’ay a cidadinas.
sentences.chineseText: 通過的學生才能戴上頭飾。

sentences.indigenousText: Mipalemed ko malitengay tamiyanan, patool ho a pa’icel i takowanan kalalok a dademak.
sentences.chineseText: 長老為我們祈福，並且勉勵我做事要認真。

sentences.indigenousText: Ya matengil ko radiw, hacecacecay sa kami a mahadak nai pitakecian, pasayra to faelohay a ’orip.
sentences.chineseText: 當聽到歌聲時，我們一個接一個走出學校，邁向新的人生。
